entry.summary:
Watch a recording of this 30 July 2025 webinar about Plan Generation in New Landonline.
In this webinar we cover off:
• How to access new Plan Generation
• Navigation, tips and tricks
• Differences between Legacy and New
• Moving CSDs from old Plan Gen to new
• Question and answer session 
Visit our self-help hub Landonline support to find lots of resources and tips to optimise your time in Landonline: 
https://www.linz.govt.nz/guidance/landonline-support/survey-support
